plain: Tied to one narrow religious or political group

webster.text: Pertaining to a sect or to sects; as sectarian principles or prejudices.

example.quote: Though I mean not to touch upon any sectarian principle of religion, yet it may be worth observing, that the genealogy of Christ is traced to Adam.
example.cite: Thomas Paine, Rights of Man, Parts One and Two (London, 1791-92)
